fusions.name: Nothing Unseen
fusions.desc: Sweeps your gaze across a 5-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 26 arcane damage to everything caught and leaving it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Slotted Glare
fusions.desc: Glares through your slotted pupils, dealing 4 arcane damage to the target and leaving it [Marked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stare-Down
fusions.desc: Stares down every creature within 5 tiles, holding them in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Looks Away
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises 10%.
